name: GitHub Search
label: GitHub REST API v3 - Repository and Release Search
description: Read-only GitHub REST API v3 node for public (and, with a PAT, authorized private) repository search, a single repository lookup, and the latest GitHub Release. EXACT actions: 'search_repositories' (default, GET /search/repositories), 'get_repo' (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}), 'get_latest_release' (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/latest). Works without auth for public data; a Personal Access Token is recommended for higher quotas and private/org repos the token can read. Search has its own quota: authenticated Search API is about 30 requests/minute; unauthenticated search is lower (typically 10/minute). Core REST with a PAT is typically 5,000 requests/hour (60/hour unauthenticated). The PAT is sent only as Authorization: Bearer and is NEVER logged or returned on the output port. Useful for competitor-displacement discovery; this node searches repositories and releases only (not issues, discussions, or code). Example input: {"action":"search_repositories","query":"language:python stars:>100 topic:automation","per_page":5}.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One GitHub REST operation. The daemon delivers this object as inputVariables.input, or as currentNode.inputList[] with targetPortValue=input (a one-element list is unwrapped to the object). Required shape: a JSON object. Choose action, then supply that action's required fields (query or q for search_repositories; owner AND repo for get_repo and get_latest_release). Unknown keys are ignored. Example: {"action":"get_repo","owner":"microsoft","repo":"autogen"}.

schema.label: action
schema.description: Which GitHub REST operation to run. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive): 'search_repositories' | 'get_repo' | 'get_latest_release'. Omit, null, or blank → 'search_repositories'. Any other string fails with output.error 'Unknown action: {action}. Use search_repositories, get_repo, or get_latest_release.' (no HTTP call). Example: 'get_latest_release'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: GitHub search syntax for action='search_repositories' (ignored by get_repo and get_latest_release). REQUIRED when action is search_repositories; omit, null, or blank fails with output.error 'query is required for search_repositories.' and no HTTP call. Alias: the same string may be sent as 'q' instead of 'query' (query wins when both are non-blank). Supports GitHub qualifiers: language:, stars:, forks:, topic:, org:, user:, in:name, in:description. Example: 'language:python stars:>100 topic:automation'.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: Search sort for action='search_repositories' only (ignored otherwise). EXACT accepted values: 'stars' | 'forks' | 'updated' | 'help-wanted-issues'. Omit, null, or blank → 'stars'. Any other string is forwarded to GitHub as-is and typically returns HTTP 422 (surfaced as output.error 'GitHub API Error: HTTP 422 for url: …'). Example: 'updated'.

schema.label: order
schema.description: Search order for action='search_repositories' only (ignored otherwise). EXACT accepted values: 'desc' | 'asc'. Omit, null, or blank → 'desc'. Any other string is forwarded to GitHub as-is and typically returns HTTP 422. Example: 'asc'.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Page size for action='search_repositories' only (ignored otherwise). Accepted: positive number or numeric string. Omit/null → instance config default_per_page (20). Values <= 0 also use that default. The request sends min(per_page, 100); GitHub's documented maximum is 100. Non-numeric strings fall back to the default. Example: 10.

schema.label: page
schema.description: 1-based search page for action='search_repositories' only (ignored otherwise). Accepted: integer or numeric string. Omit, null, or non-numeric → 1. Example: 2. GitHub Search only returns the first 1,000 matches (page * per_page must stay within that window or GitHub returns HTTP 422).

schema.label: owner
schema.description: GitHub user or organization login for action='get_repo' and action='get_latest_release' (ignored by search_repositories). REQUIRED together with repo for those actions; omit, null, or blank (either field) fails with output.error 'owner and repo are required for get_repo.' or 'owner and repo are required for get_latest_release.' and no HTTP call. Path-encoded in the URL. Not owner/repo combined — that belongs in repo as the name only. Example: 'microsoft'.

schema.label: repo
schema.description: Repository name (the name segment only, not 'owner/name') for action='get_repo' and action='get_latest_release'. REQUIRED together with owner for those actions; omit/blank fails with the same owner-and-repo error as owner. Path-encoded in the URL. Example: 'autogen'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Single OUTPUT object. Success always includes status='ok' plus action-specific fields (repositories for search_repositories, repository for get_repo, release for get_latest_release). The Personal Access Token is never present on this object. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Success flag. EXACT accepted value on success: 'ok'. Present only when the GitHub call succeeded (including get_latest_release HTTP 404, which is treated as success with release=null). Absent when output.error is set. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Total Count
schema.description: Present for action='search_repositories' only. Total matching repositories in GitHub's search index (not the page length). Integer. Omit/absent on get_repo, get_latest_release, and errors. Example: 1842.

schema.label: Repos Returned
schema.description: Present for action='search_repositories' only. Number of objects in repositories[] on this page (0 if GitHub returned no items). Integer. Absent on other actions and on errors. Example: 5.

schema.label: Rate Limit Remaining
schema.description: Present for action='search_repositories' only. Value of the X-RateLimit-Remaining response header as a string, or EXACT 'unknown' when the header is missing. Example: '29'. This is the Search API remaining quota for search_repositories, not the core REST quota.

schema.label: Repositories
schema.description: Present for action='search_repositories' only. Array of repository summaries (may be empty []). Each object has: full_name (string, e.g. 'microsoft/autogen'), description (string, truncated to 300 characters; empty string when GitHub has none), html_url (string), stargazers_count (number, default 0), forks_count (number, default 0), open_issues_count (number, default 0), language (string or null), topics (array of strings, or [] when missing), license (SPDX id string or null), pushed_at / created_at / updated_at (ISO-8601 strings, empty when missing). Absent on other actions. Example item: {"full_name":"microsoft/autogen","language":"Python","license":"MIT","topics":["agents"]}.

schema.label: Repository
schema.description: Present for action='get_repo' only. Single repository object, not truncated. Fields: full_name (string), description (full string, empty when GitHub has none — not truncated), html_url (string), stargazers_count / forks_count / open_issues_count / subscribers_count (numbers, default 0), language (string or null), topics (array or []), license (SPDX id string or null), pushed_at / created_at (ISO-8601 strings), default_branch (string, e.g. 'main'). Absent on other actions. Example: {"full_name":"microsoft/autogen","default_branch":"main","subscribers_count":1200}.

schema.label: Release
schema.description: Present for action='get_latest_release'. On success with a release: object with tag_name (string), name (string), body (string truncated to 1000 characters), published_at (ISO-8601 string), html_url (string), prerelease (boolean, default false), author (GitHub login string, empty when missing). EXACT 404 behaviour: HTTP 404 is success — release is JSON null and message is 'No releases found.' Other 4xx/5xx set output.error instead. Absent on other actions. Example: {"tag_name":"v1.2.0","prerelease":false,"author":"octocat"}.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Informational string on success paths that are not errors. EXACT value when get_latest_release hits HTTP 404: 'No releases found.' Absent on search_repositories, get_repo, a found release, and on failures (those use error). Example: 'No releases found.'.

configurationParameters.label: Personal Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Optional GitHub Personal Access Token (classic ghp_… or fine-grained github_pat_…). Omit, null, or blank → unauthenticated public API (lower rate limits; private/org repos return HTTP 404/401). Non-blank → every request adds Authorization: Bearer <token> together with Accept: application/vnd.github+json, User-Agent: StudioQuack/1.0, X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10 (current REST calendar version — https://docs.github.com/en/rest/about-the-rest-api/api-versions). NEVER logged and NEVER copied onto the output port. To obtain: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens (recommended) or Tokens (classic). For public search/details, a fine-grained token with public-repository read metadata is enough; for private org data select those repositories and read-only metadata/content. Store here as a password. Example: leave empty for public microsoft/autogen lookup.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds (connect + read) for every GitHub GET. Accepted: positive number or numeric string. Omit, null, or <= 0 → 25. Example: 25. On expiry output.error is exactly 'GitHub API Error: timed out after {n}s' where n is the timeout used. Keep this below the daemon stateful invoke budget (default 300s) or the daemon fails the node first.

configurationParameters.label: Default Per Page
configurationParameters.description: Default search page size used when input.per_page is omitted, null, or <= 0 (search_repositories only). Accepted: positive number or numeric string. Omit, null, or <= 0 → 20. The outbound request still sends min(value, 100). Example: 20. Does not affect get_repo or get_latest_release.
